_note: PROVISIONAL. Every value here was calibrated on synthetic (TTS) speech in the 2026-09-30 spike, or is illustrative. They MUST be re-tuned on real recordings of children before any real use. Not clinically validated - for demo only.

confidence._note: Segment-level gate (spec 5.4). Spike: mishearings ~ -0.9 avg_logprob, correct transcripts >= -0.45.

timing._note: Spec 5.1. Multi-word reading only: whisper-large-v3 folds pauses into the next word's span, so a gap OR a long word counts as hesitation. Single-word items use slow_start and slow_decoding_s (per section, first word start to last word end) instead.
